## New Features

- Subagent detach/attach: foreground subagents can be detached to background mode (zero-interrupt) and re-attached later, with seamless abort signal handoff via ProxyAbortController
- Team collaboration: subagents can query sibling status, track file changes across team members, and send messages (broadcast or direct) via the new TeamStatus tool
- Background task aliases: human-readable aliases for background tasks (both Agent and Bash), scoped per narrator session, with automatic conflict resolution
- Bash await mode: new `await` parameter on the Bash tool replaces the removed TaskOutput tool, supporting timeout and text-pattern matching for background bash tasks
- Subagent detach UI: SubagentCard context menu now includes "Detach to background" action with new `/narrators/:id/detach` API endpoint
- Block-level rollback context menu: ImageBlock and TextFileBlock now have right-click menus with rollback, fork, compact, and delete actions via BlockMenuWrapper

## Refactoring

- Narrator state model overhaul: main status simplified to idle/working/waiting/archived, fine-grained states expressed via substatus tag arrays (unread, error, interrupted, suspended, reasoning, compacting, etc.)
- New variant field replaces type to distinguish primary/subagent; traits field marks standalone/background characteristics
- Tool streaming input restructured from raw JSON parsing to structured streamingField mechanism — frontend no longer parses incomplete JSON
- Removed TaskOutput tool (replaced by Bash await mode and Agent resume for background agents)
- Removed forkSubagent — continueSubagent now operates in-place on the original subagent narrator
- Extracted narrator-utils.ts shared utilities; frontend status registry, WebSocket, notifications, navigation, and Ruler fully adapted
- Cross-platform build post-processing parallelized with Worker threads; added tsgo type checking
- Light theme compatibility fixes for NarratorPanel (light-dark() CSS function)

## Bug Fixes

- Terminal tool list operation now filters out exited terminals, reducing noise for AI narrators
- WebSocket subscribe now sends initial browser_session_count when active sessions exist, fixing the session count bar not appearing after page refresh
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 子代理前后台切换（Detach/Attach）：前台子代理可零中断转入后台模式，之后可重新附加到前台，通过 ProxyAbortController 实现无缝的中止信号切换
- 团队协作：子代理可查询兄弟代理状态、追踪团队成员的文件变更、通过新增的 TeamStatus 工具发送消息（广播或定向）
- 后台任务别名：为后台任务（Agent 和 Bash）提供人类可读的别名，按叙述者会话隔离，自动处理冲突
- Bash await 模式：Bash 工具新增 `await` 参数替代已移除的 TaskOutput 工具，支持超时和文本模式匹配等待后台 bash 任务
- 子代理 Detach UI：SubagentCard 右键菜单新增「转入后台」操作，配合新增的 `/narrators/:id/detach` API 端点
- 块级回退右键菜单：ImageBlock 和 TextFileBlock 现在通过 BlockMenuWrapper 提供右键菜单，支持回退、分叉、压缩和删除操作

## 重构

- 叙述者状态模型重构：主状态精简为 idle/working/waiting/archived，细粒度状态通过 substatus 标签数组表达（unread、error、interrupted、suspended、reasoning、compacting 等）
- 新增 variant 字段替代 type 区分 primary/subagent，traits 字段标记 standalone/background 等特征
- 工具流式输入从原始 JSON 解析改为结构化 streamingField 机制，前端不再解析不完整 JSON
- 移除 TaskOutput 工具（由 Bash await 模式和 Agent resume 替代）
- 移除 forkSubagent — continueSubagent 改为在原子代理叙述者上原地续写
- 提取 narrator-utils.ts 公共工具函数，前端状态注册表、WebSocket、通知、导航、Ruler 全面适配
- 跨平台构建后处理改用 Worker 线程并行化，添加 tsgo 类型检查
- NarratorPanel 亮色主题兼容性修复（light-dark() CSS 函数）

## 修复

- 终端工具的 list 操作现在过滤已退出终端，减少 AI 叙述者的噪音
- WebSocket 订阅时如果存在活跃浏览器会话，立即发送初始 browser_session_count，修复页面刷新后计数条不显示的问题
